name: @papercusp/templates
description: The templates/ source-of-truth dir as a runnable workspace member (plan app-templates-2026-07-04 P-006/P-007). Runs the template checks in-repo: composition-integrity executes UNCONFIGURED against the sibling template.yamls (the release gate pins it continuously); the app-parameterized checks (confinement-guard, seam-round-trip, gym-signals, boot-e2e) SKIP unless TEMPLATE_CHECKS_CONFIG names a checks-config JSON — the template gym (P-009) and a materialized app run them configured. The check .test.ts files under <id>/checks/ are the PORTABLE template content the materializer copies into a built app; this package.json is repo plumbing, never copied.
